## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test, or a note explaining why not
- [ ] No emoji added anywhere (Lucide icons only)
- [ ] No borders, outlines or focus rings added (focus is tint plus glow)
- [ ] Every new dialog, menu, select, switch, tab or radio group uses Headless UI
- [ ] Works offline: no new network calls, no new third-party service
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or setup changed
